rules.requirement: Use the owner-authorized full-width game-led homepage with 20–40px side gutters, finite content height and no empty footer band. Homepage category modules are forbidden.
Use sensible readable desktop ordinary-card capacity; prior opening base-track geometry must not force twelve tiny cards into the lower homepage
Three ordinary phone columns after the opening feature group; stable last row
Preserve brand; vary feature count/placement and component paint
Real browser runtime selects playable landing; store-only retains download detail
White/light neutral canvas and facts; no icon backdrop
Content-sized identity, 120–200px desktop icon and 80–90px phone icon
Icon/title plus one or two verified category/rating/download facts
Fact labels14–16, values12–15, prose15–17 CSS px
Blue/green official store buttons and readable contrast
Screenshot viewport/images no higher than320px, intrinsic ratios and usable controls
No breadcrumb/header/eyebrow above identity

Follow the current task's approved reference and authorized modules inside the current 1200px content container and required top recommendation row; do not apply an earlier Topziz or Mzgen skeleton to every brand.
Logo and functional search icon only, maximum50px header; actual visible logo dimensions and working known/empty/reset search
How-to box is optional. Hover/focus must communicate a game action with game wording, gamepad or arrow; no triangular video-play button and no forced identical overlay.

Keep brand-coherent surfaces and brighter, higher-purity game-action colors with readable contrast; old blue/green-only web-play surface directions are superseded. Store-only platform button restrictions remain scoped.
One coherent recommendation rail without height coupling
Highlighted strip/body and rail/main visible separations at most20px
Game, side recommendations, immediate lower recommendations, bottom information
Desktop left/right game and recommendations; no initial fullscreen-only mode
Real recommendations present; controls/help cannot replace them; persistent readable names at rest on phone detail/play recommendations
Readable title/prose/control text on actual nested surfaces; nested controls and meaningful supporting text meet4.5:1
No intervening toolbar/text/module between game and lower recommendations
Same title/image/runtime/store entity; truthful facts, working actions, static first paint; natural and rendered brand dimensions are positive; meaningful nested text remains legible

Ordinary/recommended game names stay one line and ellipsize when necessary, including sidebar and below-content cards. Preserve full DOM/accessibility and full main game title, summary and body. Do not shrink text to evade capacity.

Within each brand/card family, use reasonable caption inset and consistent capacity; inspect real first/middle/long-name/last items, stable image roles and equal ordinary-row geometry. Do not stretch the final row or let short labels create empty panels.

A repeated-component defect triggers proactive inspection of all affected siblings: sidebar, lower recommendations, home/detail/play variants, search repaint, hover/focus, long names and last rows. Fix equivalent defects without separate owner reports; declare exact visual samples and exhaustive static identity/link/media coverage.

Where search is present, check real long-name results after typing at desktop and narrow widths: one-line ellipsis, fixed intended thumbnail size, min-width/flex capacity, clear/empty states and correct result navigation. An absent search must not leave a fake entry.

Primary game action wording/icon/hit area remain complete and readable on PC,393,320 and intermediate breakpoint neighbors. Avoid unintended button-label wrapping or crowding; remove redundant optional ornament before shrinking important text.
Measure actual stage width when aspect-ratio and minimum height coexist: constrain it to its parent at narrow widths, with no root overflow. Fix component sizing rather than masking the root page.

Use purposeful game hover/focus/pressed feedback with PLAY GAME/gamepad/arrow or equivalent game action; no video-play triangle. Feedback must not move neighbors, hide essential names or depend on hover for phone access.

Each brand owns an animated loading treatment with real recovery and reduced-motion behavior. Distinguish iframe document load from engine readiness; do not invent progress/completion or claim network games are playable offline.

Use real source-linked title/artwork/summary/About/How/runtime. Do not invent categories, ratings, descriptions or extra blocks; do not import reference videos, advertising blanks, scripts or broken details without explicit authorization. Inspect reference problems instead of reproducing them.

The latest user-approved reference and explicit exclusions own the requested design. Earlier geometry and a prior internal pass do not override a later owner correction; historical releases remain immutable.

For multi-site work, complete and check one site before authoring the next. Compare the same real detail/play entities and ordinary cards at equal PC/phone widths. Grouping, reading order, artwork/action relation and recommendation construction must be independently designed; names/colors/images alone do not count. Shared facts/behavior do not authorize one common visual renderer.

Verify the reported and reviewed build IDs and same entity/route. Preserve immutable old links/artifacts; safely use the corresponding current page for review without discarding active user state. Preview and downloadable ZIP must match the same accepted candidate.

Center game names beneath their artwork within the actual card, with balanced caption insets and one-line ellipsis. Include phone row-to-grid regrouping. Do not center prose, main identities or desktop horizontal image/text rows by analogy.

If an authorized homepage discovery interaction is retained, it performs a useful brand-specific task. It must not add category modules or introductory subtitle copy. Finish and check one site before the next.
On actual list/category pages, use real bound games, recorded editorial inferences, derived counts and matching local routes. This rule does not permit a homepage category module.
Working local About, Privacy and Contacts pages, truthful product/storage/contact content, footer links on every page family and a valid return route; desktop/phone/320 navigation checked.

View all/See more and equivalent section browsing entries use a visible-at-rest button or named icon tag in this brand’s action language, not bare text, underline or text plus arrow. Preserve real link destinations, 44px targets, responsive capacity and hover/focus/pressed states; ordinary prose/footer links retain their roles. Canonical design rule: Designer-Automation brand-section-actions@2026-10-27.1.
Homepage uses the full viewport width with 20–40 CSS px visible side gutters; no narrow centered homepage canvas. Measure desktop and phone actual boundaries.
Prefer square game icon/artwork frames with stable space; preserve the actual identity and avoid distorted artwork.
Homepage game information appears on hover, keyboard focus and deliberate tap/click. Phone disclosure and navigation are usable without hover; full accessible names remain available.
A hover button is not a fixed requirement. Across brands vary useful information/action presentation; do not impose one overlay/button skin.

Do not place category modules, genre/category sections or category browsing blocks on the homepage. Existing category pages remain independently valid; earlier lower-home category requirements are superseded.
Background patterns, texture, geometry or illustration have a clear game-related logic, restrained attention and coherent top-to-bottom transitions, with no arbitrary shapes or visible seams.
Include a top row of real game-icon recommendations in the current brand style, before the main game identity. Bind each icon to its own game and keep the row usable on phones.
Desktop detail and play content containers have a 1200 CSS px width when space permits, with responsive max-width containment on narrower screens. This replaces historical 1180px observations.
PC How to play content uses one column by default; do not split it into two columns. Preserve actual instructions and natural reading order.

For the actual Sky Swarm module, locate the current candidate and repair the reported abnormal layout using real whole-module/neighbor/PC/phone evidence. No precise rejected geometry or screenshot was supplied in this message; do not invent it or claim a text rule fixes the module.
Bottom game information shares the main page content container width and alignment; do not leave it in a narrower unrelated track.

The loading background is an Image-generated refined flat illustration with a game atmosphere, composed for this brand and game, with purposeful animation and reduced-motion behavior. Keep generation provenance and local files.

Show a loading progress bar. Bind determinate progress to observed real loading/engine progress; when progress cannot be observed use a clearly indeterminate bar without invented percentages or fake completion. Preserve failure/retry and distinguish frame load from engine readiness.
Do not show a fullscreen button on PC. Preserve ordinary responsive game operation without adding a redundant desktop fullscreen control.
Do not show a separate Back to detail button. Preserve normal browser/exit/recovery navigation and avoid trapping the player.

Every interactive target on mobile has visible, purposeful pressed/tap feedback: cards, links, buttons, icon controls, menus, search results, pagination and runtime-shell actions. Cover redraw states and reduced-motion; feedback must not move neighboring layout.

Module heading areas contain the title without introductory/descriptive subtitle copy. Preserve necessary game description, How to play body, factual conditions and status/error messages in their actual content roles.

Buttons use brighter, higher-purity colors that remain harmonious with the page and game atmosphere; check rendered text/icon contrast and all interaction states. Existing narrower store-platform color rules still apply.

Use Image-generated refined linear icons for new/replaced game and game-UI icon assets, with coherent stroke/scale and usable labels. Save generation evidence and local assets; editorial game artwork must not masquerade as official screenshots.

Text uses the full width of its assigned content container before natural wrapping. Remove unnecessary hard line breaks, narrow inner wrappers and arbitrary ch widths that cause early wrapping; preserve paragraph semantics, long-word safety and explicitly required ordinary-name ellipsis.

At phone widths every visible text role, including headings, navigation, controls and states, has computed font-size no greater than 24 CSS px. Preserve applicable readability minimums; fix hierarchy and grouping rather than hiding text.

Run the bundled read-only bin/inspect-games.mjs against actual mapped modules at PC/phone/320 and real breakpoint neighbors; supplement geometry with actual pixel, pressed-state, generated-asset and runtime evidence. Missing mappings/capability remain not-run.

applicability: Accumulates direct owner corrections and approved-reference precedence. Applies to new/authorized maintenance scope; frozen historical releases retain their own rules.
